content_data.meeting_title: Q4 Regulatory Compliance Strategy & Cross-Border Payment Infrastructure Review
agenda_items: Discussion of SOC 2 Type II audit findings and remediation timeline
Review of proposed budget allocation for compliance technology upgrades
Timeline for implementing enhanced KYC verification protocols across all markets
key_decisions: Deferred expansion into Mexican market pending regulatory clarity on digital payment licensing

Approved enhanced due diligence protocols for high-risk merchant categories effective within 60 days
Approved $2.3M investment in AI-driven transaction monitoring platform to replace legacy system over 14 months

Priya Deshmukh to coordinate vendor selection process for transaction monitoring platform and present top 3 options within 30 days
